guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit Limitless and Connect Your Wallet
guide.description: Go to the Limitless platform and connect a Web3 wallet such as MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet. Approve the connection request.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Switch to Base and Fund Your Wallet
guide.description: Set your wallet to the Base network and add USDC to cover trades. You can buy USDC or ETH on Binance , then move funds to Base using the bridge widget below if they sit on another chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Place Trades on Active Markets
guide.description: Browse the open markets and take positions on the outcomes you want. Markets with deeper liquidity and clear resolution rules tend to score better and carry less slippage.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Reach the $200 Volume Minimum
guide.description: Hit at least $200 in trading volume to qualify for Season 4, then keep trading through the season to accumulate points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Points and the Weekly Leaderboard
guide.description: Check your volume and points on the dashboard. The leaderboard refreshes every Monday, so use it to see where you stand against other traders.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: User Generated Markets are Live
guide.description: Limitless has opened User-Generated Markets, letting anyone create their own prediction market by picking an asset, choosing an outcome, and launching it on the Create a Market page . Every market you launch pays you a share of the fees it generates from trading activity, for as long as people keep trading it.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Season 3 Allocation
guide.description: If you traded during Season 3, open the claim portal , connect the wallet you used, and confirm the claim transaction. 3% of the total LMTS supply allocated to platform traders.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Apply to the Program
guide.description: Submit your application through the application form . The team reviews candidates based on their contributions and engagement history.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
